⚠️ Quick heads up about Discord + Jurassic Front

Just wanted to warn you guys because I’ve seen this happen a few times lately.

Basically, random people DM you, usually pretending they messaged the wrong person, then start talking to you and asking what games you play. After a bit they bring up Jurassic Front: Survival and try to get you to download it or click something.

The game itself is real, but these random DMs are suspicious.

So if someone you don’t know randomly talks to you about JFS:

don’t click any links they send
don’t download anything from them
don’t give them your Discord/email/password or any codes
don’t give them personal info
just block/report them if they start pushing you into it
Just be careful, especially if the conversation starts with a random “sorry wrong person” 😭
